title.zh: 高温包覆成型电缆组件

intro.en: Custom high-temperature overmolded cable assemblies coordinate the conductor system, insulation, connector or sensor insert, molding material, process temperature, sealing geometry and validation around the real thermal profile.
intro.zh: 定制高温包覆成型电缆组件围绕真实温度谱，协同定义导体体系、绝缘、连接器或传感器嵌件、成型材料、工艺温度、密封几何与验证。

knowledge.en: High temperature is not one material label. Continuous exposure, short peaks, thermal cycling, current-generated heat, fluids and the molding process itself can create different failure modes.
knowledge.zh: 高温不是一个材料标签。持续暴露、短时峰值、冷热循环、电流自发热、介质以及成型工艺本身，会产生不同失效模式。

notes.en: Provide the operating and peak temperatures at every zone, dwell and cycle profile, cable and insert materials, circuits, fluids, sealing target, mounting and required test method.
notes.zh: 请提供各温区工作与峰值温度、停留与循环谱、线缆和嵌件材料、回路、介质、密封目标、安装与所需试验方法。

delivery.en: Release records the material identities, preconditioning, tooling, process window, critical dimensions and agreed electrical, mechanical, sealing and thermal evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录材料身份、预处理、工装、工艺窗口、关键尺寸与约定的电气、机械、密封及热学证据。

displayTitle.zh: 高温包覆成型电缆组件

subtitle.en: Protect the electrical path through heat, cycling and material change
subtitle.zh: 让电气路径跨越高温、循环与材料变化

lead.en: Separate service temperature from molding temperature, then engineer every interface between them.
lead.zh: 先区分使用温度与成型温度，再设计两者之间的每一处材料界面。

title.en: Map Continuous, Peak and Process Temperatures Separately
title.zh: 分别绘制持续、峰值与工艺温度

copy.en: The cable may see one temperature near a heater, another at the connector and a third inside a housing. Specify continuous operating temperature, short-duration peak, start-up transient, current-generated temperature rise, thermal-cycle rate and dwell. The injection or curing process adds a separate heat exposure that can damage insulation, plating, solder, adhesives or electronics before the product enters service. A single maximum-temperature number cannot describe these conditions.
copy.zh: 线缆在加热器附近、连接器处与壳体内部可能面对不同温度。应分别规定持续工作温度、短时峰值、启动瞬态、电流温升、冷热循环速率与停留时间。注塑或固化又会增加一次独立热暴露，产品尚未投入使用便可能伤及绝缘、镀层、焊料、胶黏剂或电子器件。单一最高温度无法描述这些条件。

title.en: Select the Exact Polymer System, Not a Generic Family Name
title.zh: 选择准确聚合物体系，而不只是材料家族

copy.en: Silicone elastomers, fluorinated elastomers, high-temperature thermoplastics and engineered potting or molding compounds offer different heat aging, compression set, flexibility, chemical resistance, dielectric behavior and processing needs. Even within one family, grade, hardness, fillers, cure chemistry and color package can change performance. The selected compound must fit the cable jacket, insert geometry, required flexibility, environment and approved processing window; brand-family temperature tables are screening data, not finished-assembly proof.
copy.zh: 硅橡胶、含氟弹性体、高温热塑性塑料以及工程灌封或成型材料，在热老化、压缩永久变形、柔性、耐化学品、介电表现与加工要求上各不相同。即使属于同一家族，牌号、硬度、填料、固化体系与色母也会改变性能。选定材料必须匹配线缆护套、嵌件几何、柔性、环境与获准工艺窗口；材料家族温度表只能用于初筛，不能替代成品证据。

title.en: Adhesion and Compatibility Begin at the Existing Surface
title.zh: 粘接与相容性从原有表面开始

copy.en: The overmold meets jacket, connector housing, metal insert, seal, adhesive and sometimes a circuit board. Plasticizer migration, low-surface-energy polymers, mold release, oxidation and contamination can reduce adhesion; excessive shrink or chemical attack can crack the insert. Mechanical locks, grooves, primers, plasma or other surface treatment may be evaluated, but each changes process control. A sealed appearance is not evidence of a stable bond after heat and fluid exposure.
copy.zh: 包覆料会接触护套、连接器壳体、金属嵌件、密封件、胶黏剂，有时还会接触电路板。增塑剂迁移、低表面能材料、脱模剂、氧化与污染会降低粘接，过大收缩或化学侵蚀会使嵌件开裂。机械锁合、沟槽、底涂、等离子或其他表面处理可以评估，但每一种都会增加工艺控制。外观看似密封，并不能证明经历热与介质后仍保持稳定结合。

title.en: Drying, Preheating and Cleanliness Stabilize the Process
title.zh: 干燥、预热与清洁让工艺稳定

copy.en: Moisture in hygroscopic resin can cause hydrolysis, voids, splay or reduced properties. Cold inserts may freeze the flow front or promote condensation; excessive preheat may soften insulation, shift contacts or accelerate oxidation. Cable cut, strip, termination, shield preparation and insert cleaning must be controlled before molding. Storage time after drying, regrind limits, lot traceability and mixed-material contamination belong in the released work instruction.
copy.zh: 吸湿树脂中的水分会造成水解、气泡、银纹或性能下降。过冷嵌件可能冻结流动前沿或产生凝露，预热过度则会软化绝缘、推动触点或加速氧化。成型前要控制裁线、剥线、端接、屏蔽处理与嵌件清洁。干燥后存放时间、回料限制、批次追溯与混料污染都应进入放行作业文件。

title.en: Tooling Controls Flow, Pressure, Venting and Insert Position
title.zh: 模具控制流动、压力、排气与嵌件位置

copy.en: Gate location and flow path determine how molten or reactive material loads the cable and insert. Clamping pressure must hold the interface without crushing insulation or allowing flash; vents release displaced air without creating a leak path. Core pins, shutoffs and nests control contact position, cable exit and sealing wall thickness. Simulation can guide the design, but first articles must be sectioned or otherwise inspected where hidden knit lines, voids and wire movement are credible risks.
copy.zh: 浇口位置与流动路径决定熔融或反应材料如何载荷线缆与嵌件。夹持压力既要固定接口，又不能压伤绝缘或产生飞边；排气要释放空气，又不能形成渗漏路径。芯针、封胶位与定位巢控制触点位置、出线方向和密封壁厚。模拟可辅助设计，但在熔接线、空洞与芯线移动可能发生的位置，首件仍应通过剖切或其他方法检查。

title.en: Wall Thickness and Strain Relief Must Transfer Load Gradually
title.zh: 壁厚与应力释放要渐进传递载荷

copy.en: Abrupt thick-to-thin transitions create uneven cooling and shrink, while a rigid overmold ending beside a flexible cable creates a hinge. Ribs, radii, cable anchors and boot length should move pull, bend and torsion into the assembly gradually. Geometry also sets creepage, clearance, sealing land and tool access. A larger overmold is not automatically stronger: excess mass can increase thermal gradients, cycle time, sink and stress on the insert.
copy.zh: 厚薄突变会造成冷却与收缩不均，刚性包覆若直接终止在柔性线缆旁，则会形成铰链。加强筋、圆角、线缆锚固与尾套长度应逐步把拉力、弯曲和扭转载荷传入组件。几何同时决定爬电距离、电气间隙、密封面与工装空间。更大的包覆体并不一定更强，过多材料反而增加温差、周期、缩痕与嵌件应力。

title.en: A High-Temperature Seal Is an Interface System
title.zh: 高温密封是一套界面系统

copy.en: Fluid ingress may follow the cable strands, shield, connector cavities or the overmold boundary. Heat cycling pumps air and moisture through small gaps as materials expand at different rates. Define whether the part is sealed while mated, unmated or both, and specify the fluid, pressure, depth, spray, dwell and temperature. Potting, overmolding, gaskets and wire seals can complement each other, but component ratings do not automatically transfer to the complete assembly.
copy.zh: 液体可能沿芯线、屏蔽、连接器腔体或包覆边界进入。材料热膨胀速率不同，冷热循环会像泵一样把空气与水分推过微小缝隙。要明确产品在插合、未插合或两种状态下密封，并规定介质、压力、深度、喷淋、停留与温度。灌封、包覆、垫片与线密封可以互补，但元件等级不会自动转移到完整组件。

title.en: Validate Electrical, Mechanical, Sealing and Thermal Functions Together
title.zh: 把电气、机械、密封与热学功能放在一起验证

copy.en: Inspection may include wiring, resistance, insulation resistance, dielectric withstand when specified, dimensions, contact position, pull, flex, leak or ingress checks and visual criteria. Heat aging and thermal cycling should use representative mounting, electrical load, mating state and fluids, with intermediate monitoring capable of finding intermittent faults. Post-exposure pull, seal and section inspection can reveal embrittlement, delamination, void growth or conductor damage. Test severities and pass limits must come from the project requirement—not from the material name alone.
copy.zh: 检验可包括接线、电阻、绝缘电阻、规定时的耐电压、尺寸、触点位置、拉力、弯曲、泄漏或进水检查与外观判据。热老化和冷热循环要采用代表性安装、电气负载、插合状态与介质，并通过中间监控发现间歇故障。暴露后的拉力、密封与剖切检查可发现脆化、分层、空洞增长或导体损伤。试验严酷度与合格限值必须来自项目要求，不能只由材料名称决定。

inputs.en: Continuous, peak and transient temperatures at each zone, including dwell and ramp
inputs.zh: 各温区持续、峰值与瞬态温度，包括停留与升降温速率

inputs.en: Exact cable, jacket, connector, insert, seal, adhesive and electronic materials
inputs.zh: 准确线缆、护套、连接器、嵌件、密封、胶黏剂与电子材料

inputs.en: Circuits, current, voltage, signal, shielding, grounding and self-heating limits
inputs.zh: 回路、电流、电压、信号、屏蔽、接地与自发热限值

inputs.en: Mounting, bend, pull, vibration, fluids, cleaning, pressure and ingress target
inputs.zh: 安装、弯曲、拉力、振动、介质、清洁、压力与防护目标

inputs.en: Critical dimensions, surface appearance, color, marking and traceability
inputs.zh: 关键尺寸、表面外观、颜色、标识与追溯

inputs.en: Sample quantity and required electrical, mechanical, sealing and thermal methods
inputs.zh: 样品数量与所需电气、机械、密封及热学方法

q.en: What temperature makes an overmold high-temperature?
q.zh: 多少温度才算高温包覆？

a.en: There is no universal threshold. The service profile, material system, electrical load, fluids, life and test method define whether a construction is suitable.
a.zh: 没有通用门槛。使用温度谱、材料体系、电气负载、介质、寿命与试验方法共同决定结构是否适用。

q.en: Is silicone always the best high-temperature material?
q.zh: 硅胶一定是最好的高温材料吗？

a.en: No. Silicone can offer useful heat and flexibility performance, while adhesion, tear, fluids, compression set, processing, cost and regulatory needs may favor another exact compound.
a.zh: 不一定。硅胶可能提供良好耐热与柔性，但粘接、撕裂、介质、压缩永久变形、工艺、成本与法规可能使其他准确配方更合适。

q.en: Can an existing connector be overmolded?
q.zh: 现有连接器可以直接包覆成型吗？

a.en: Possibly, after checking resin compatibility, heat and pressure tolerance, sealing paths, contact retention, geometry and the ability to locate and vent the insert safely.
a.zh: 可能可以，但要先确认树脂相容性、耐热耐压、密封路径、触点保持、几何以及安全定位和排气能力。

q.en: Does overmolding automatically create an IP-rated seal?
q.zh: 包覆成型会自动形成 IP 防护吗？

a.en: No. The complete assembly, mating state, cable path, connector cavities and specified exposure method determine sealing performance.
a.zh: 不会。完整组件、插合状态、线缆路径、连接器腔体与规定暴露方法共同决定密封表现。

q.en: Why can a part fail after thermal cycling even if it passes at room temperature?
q.zh: 为什么室温合格的产品会在冷热循环后失效？

a.en: Different expansion rates can create pumping, delamination, seal loss, wire movement or contact stress that is not visible in an initial room-temperature test.
a.zh: 不同热膨胀率会造成泵吸、分层、密封丧失、芯线移动或触点应力，这些问题在初始室温测试中可能不可见。

a.en: Send the temperature map, duty cycle, exact inserts and cable, circuits, environment, sealing target, dimensions, quantity and required validation.
a.zh: 请提供温度图、工况循环、准确嵌件与线缆、回路、环境、密封目标、尺寸、数量与所需验证。
